purpose: Preserve the gross-withdrawal/net-requirement boundary used as a validation benchmark for Philippines v16; no value in this snapshot is installed in the model.

observations.boundary_note: Agricultural withdrawal is broader than irrigation-only withdrawal and can include livestock and aquaculture uses.
FAO defines this as net irrigation water requirement; delivery losses are excluded.

computed_ratio.interpretation: Boundary check only because the numerator is irrigation-only while variable 4250 is broader agricultural withdrawal.

aquastat_2012_table_4.interpretation: This is the internally comparable FAO withdrawal/requirement pair underlying the published 51 percent ratio.

reviewed_claim.disposition: Do not cite 67.965 as a 2020 FAO observation. It was not reproduced as a single current AQUASTAT Philippines record, and 33.28 / 67.965 equals 48.97 percent rather than 51 percent.

methodology.caution: AQUASTAT reports country data of mixed reference years and methods. Ratios are useful for data-quality review, but a national aggregate does not identify crop-, scheme-, or region-specific conveyance and application efficiency.
